pocket-cpa.decision: Compare the promised preparation continuity and projection cadence with AE’s separately scoped advisory and filing work. Clarify who recalculates payments and who checks that the return reflects completed recommendations.

kkos-lawyers.boundary: A tax adviser and a law firm may have complementary roles. Do not assume an AE advisory engagement replaces legal counsel, or that a KKOS consultation includes ongoing accounting and return preparation.

kkos-lawyers.decision: Ask KKOS to scope the legal and consultation work and AE to scope any tax analysis and implementation coordination. You may need both kinds of professional; compare only overlapping work and identify gaps between the agreements.
